name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Translation Agency for Claude Code: what needs a decision, the bookings and the deadlines, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Worst first. An uncovered booking, an interpreter without the credential, or a certified translation without a certified translator outranks everything.
sections.sql: select rank, reason, label, who, detail from v_attention order by rank, days desc nulls last, label limit 25

sections.title: Interpreting, the next seven days
sections.sql: select ref as booking, to_char(starts_at, 'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as starts, language, mode, setting, client, coalesce(interpreter, 'NOBODY') as interpreter from v_bookings where status in ('open', 'assigned') and on_date between current_date and current_date + 7 order by starts_at

sections.title: Translations due, the next seven days
sections.note: Revised means a second linguist has finished checking every translation in it.
sections.sql: select ref as project, to_char(due_on, 'Dy DD Mon') as due, client, title, source_lang || ' > ' || target_lang as pair, case when certified then 'yes' else '' end as certified, coalesce(translator, 'nobody') as translator, coalesce(reviser, 'nobody') as reviser, case when revision_ok then 'yes' else 'not yet' end as revised from v_projects where status = 'open' and due_on <= current_date + 7 order by due_on

sections.title: NAATI credentials to renew
sections.sql: select linguist, type, source_lang as from_lang, target_lang as to_lang, expires_on, days_left, state from v_credentials where state <> 'current' order by expires_on

name: money
title: Money
subtitle: Translation Agency for Claude Code: margin after linguist costs, what is owed both ways, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Margin by client, last 90 days
sections.note: What the client paid less what the linguists were paid, ex GST.
sections.sql: select client, count(*) as items, to_char(sum(price_cents) / 100.0, 'FM$999,990') as charged, to_char(sum(margin_cents) / 100.0, 'FM$999,990') as left_after_linguists, round(sum(margin_cents) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(price_cents), 0), 1) as margin_pct from v_margins where on_date >= current_date - 90 group by client order by margin_pct

sections.title: Margin by service and language
sections.sql: select line as service, pair, count(*) as items, round(sum(margin_cents) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(price_cents), 0), 1) as margin_pct from v_margins where on_date >= current_date - 90 group by line, pair order by margin_pct

sections.title: Finished and not invoiced
sections.sql: select ref as item, client, done_on, description, to_char(amount_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,990.00') as ex_gst from v_unbilled order by done_on

sections.title: Invoices open
sections.sql: select ref, client, status, issued_on, due_on, to_char(total_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,990.00') as ex_gst, days_overdue from v_invoices where status in ('draft', 'issued') order by days_overdue desc, ref

sections.title: Owed to linguists
sections.sql: select linguist, count(*) as items, min(done_on) as oldest, to_char(sum(amount_cents) / 100.0, 'FM$999,990.00') as amount from v_payables group by linguist order by linguist

name: panel
title: The panel
subtitle: Translation Agency for Claude Code: who works in what, their NAATI credentials and their load, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Linguists
sections.sql: select l.ref, l.name, l.kind, coalesce(l.competence, 'NOT RECORDED') as competence, coalesce(l.nda_signed_on::text, 'NOT ON FILE') as confidentiality_agreement, (select string_agg(source_lang || ' > ' || target_lang, ', ' order by source_lang) from linguist_pairs p where p.linguist_id = l.id) as translates, (select count(*) from jobs j where j.linguist_id = l.id and j.status = 'assigned') as jobs_open, (select count(*) from bookings b where b.linguist_id = l.id and b.status = 'assigned') as bookings_open from linguists l where l.status = 'active' order by l.name

sections.title: NAATI credentials
sections.sql: select linguist, type, source_lang as from_lang, target_lang as to_lang, number, expires_on, state from v_credentials order by linguist, type

sections.title: Language pairs with one linguist or none
sections.note: Where a single sick day stops the work. A revision needs a second linguist in the same direction.
sections.sql: select source_lang || ' > ' || target_lang as pair, count(*) as linguists, string_agg(l.name, ', ') as who from linguist_pairs p join linguists l on l.id = p.linguist_id and l.status = 'active' group by source_lang, target_lang having count(*) < 2 order by pair
